en: Dependent on a cause that leads to accumulation (*ācayagāmi*), a non-cause phenomenon that does not lead to accumulation arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … [In the case of] root, three; … [and so on] … in the case of non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a cause that leads to diminution (*apacayagāmi*), a non-cause phenomenon that does not lead to diminution arises by way of the root condition … [In the case of] root, three; … [and so on] … in the case of non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a non-cause phenomenon that leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution, a non-cause phenomenon that leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution arises by way of the root condition … [In the case of] root, three; … [and so on] … in the case of non-disappearance, three.
